deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollout encoder-service v3 -> v4 (canary 10%) 4990012345
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: encoder-service crashlooping on gpu-pool. Severity: Sev2. @oncall 4990012350
maya: seeing crashloop on encoder-0 and encoder-1 on gpu-nodes,  OOMKilled repeatedly. liveness probe failing. 4990012360
tony: confirming logs: `kubelet: eviction due to memory` then `SIGTERM` then restart. 4990012375
alex: canary traffic at 10% for v4 — looks like bigger mem footprint than v3 (peak ~14GB vs 7GB). 4990012380
jen: customer-facing symptoms? CS dashboard shows a small spike in 502s for hosted customers routing to encoder. Dedicated customers on pool eu-west-1a impacted ~5% of requests. 4990012388
maya: rolling back canary now. executing: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/encoder-service --to-revision=3` 4990012395
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by maya. Progress: 1/3 replicas terminated, 0/3 updated. 4990012400
tony: also toggling feature flag to force old code path while we triage: `ffctl set encoder.use_v4 false --env prod` 4990012410
alex: feature flag flip succeeded. Confirming new requests hitting v3 only. 4990012415
jen: CS notified impacted customers in channel and opened ticket CS-4821. Will send templated note + ETA. 4990012420
maya: mitigation status: rollback progressing, pods coming back to Ready on v3. Memory stable on nodes. 4990012430
ops-lead: good. we should preserve logs and core dumps. @maya please snapshot logs from encoder-v4 pods: `kubectl logs -p encoder-0` and `kubectl cp` to s3 path s3://redwood-debug/enc-v4/4990012435 4990012440
maya: grabbing logs and pod manifests now, saving to s3://redwood-debug/enc-v4/4990012445
alex: quick triage note: v4 enabled new batching logic + larger kv-cache default. suspect default cache size not gated by available GPU memory. 4990012460
ton y: can we reproduce on staging with same model weights and kv-cache=on? I'll spin a repro job. 4990012465
jen: CS: notifying affected enterprise customers about rollback and mitigation, asking for confirmation if they still see errors. 4990012470
incident-bot: Incident update: rollback completed to v3; service latency and error rate returning to baseline. Severity downgraded to P1-monitoring. 4990012480
ops-lead: We'll keep this open until we validate root cause and deploy a safe v4 with kv-cache limit. Assign to alex and tony for root cause + safe rollout plan. 4990012490
maya: handing off to next shift oncall (tony) for overnight monitoring. Details in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/encoder-deploy-fail. Notes: logs at s3://redwood-debug/enc-v4/, rollback timestamp 4990012395. 4990012500
tony: ack, taking handoff. I'll run a cluster-wide memory sweep and hold off any further v4 rollouts until we have kv-cache cap and canary at 1%. 4990012515
jen: CS will update customers with final postmortem link once RC validated. 4990012520
alex: locally repro'd OOM with kv-cache default. Proposed fix: cap kv-cache to 6GB for gpu-small nodes and add autosetting based on node memory left. Will open PR with test plan and smoke canary. 4990012535
ops-lead: good plan. add canary feature flag gating + limit, and configure auto-rollback threshold to 5% errors in 5m. 4990012545
jen: closing note for customers: immediate impact mitigated by rollback + ff kill-switch. Monitoring for 2h post-rollback. 4990012550
incident-bot: Incident resolved -> monitoring. Close after 2h stable. 4990014200
